image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two stacked Apple iPods (likely Classic models) on a dark reflective surface. The top iPod has a red metallic casing with a white click wheel; the bottom one is blue/silver with an illuminated screen showing a menu interface. White charging cables and power adapters are scattered in the foreground and background, creating a cluttered but tech-focused composition.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the illuminated screen is illegible and nonsensical. While it mimics the layout of a menu list, the characters are malformed blobs rather than readable letters, a common AI artifact in rendering UI text.

artifact_observations.location: White power adapter/cable junction in foreground
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white blocky adapter in the lower left connects to a cable that seems to merge into the block without a clear port or strain relief. The geometry of the plug head is slightly warped and lacks precise mechanical definition.
The edge where the red iPod sits on the blue iPod shows slight softness and blending of shadows, lacking the crisp hard-edge contact expected from two rigid metal/plastic objects.

The reflection on the red casing is overly smooth and uniform, lacking the micro-scratches or subtle surface imperfections typical of real used electronics, giving it a slightly 'plastic toy' appearance despite the metallic intent.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic vs Nano vs Shuffle) and verify brand authenticity features.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the display, confirming if it is gibberish or valid UI.
To check for melting or fusion artifacts in the complex white cable structures and their connection points to the adapters.
To verify the physical separation and stacking order of the two devices, ensuring no spatial bleeding occurs between them.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the screen text quality. Even if the classifier identifies it as an iPod, illegible UI text is a significant artifact. Also, inspect the white accessories for 'melted' geometry, as AI often struggles with thin, winding cables and precise plug shapes.
